premises.text: Owners hate shop logistics and opaque pricing for routine and unexpected car repairs

premises.text: Web booking shows comparable fixed prices, mechanic reviews, and schedules service at the customer's place
premises.evidence_span: You can see our price. You can compare it with dealer and shop price. You can see mechanics' ratings and reviews

premises.text: Platform knowledge of parts and labor times plus supplier integration keeps prices fixed and fair
premises.evidence_span: this allows us to give you a fixed, fair price every time

premises.text: Mobile mechanics with personal tools cover most repairs and improve earnings versus shop wage splits
premises.evidence_span: Because when you go to the shop and pay $120 an hour, I make $20 of those dollars

premises.text: Large installed base of older cars spending hundreds yearly on local garage repairs defines the opportunity

value.text: Best car repair experience delivered at home or work with fair fixed pricing
